added.statement: Home Manager shall own a portable cargo-pgrx entrypoint that delegates to the nearest Engine fabrics/data development shell, with the canonical Engine checkout as fallback.
acceptance_criteria: home/home.nix imports the dedicated cargo-pgrx module
the module owns executable ~/.local/bin/cargo-pgrx
the wrapper walks upward from the current directory to find fabrics/data/flake.nix
the wrapper accepts an ancestor only when Engine-specific Cargo and Nix package markers are present
the wrapper falls back to /home/mhugo/code/singularity-engine/fabrics/data
the wrapper delegates all original arguments through the Nix-owned cargo-pgrx and cannot select itself inside the nested shell
the canonical repo check executes the wrapper logic against controlled workspace, argv, unrelated-flake, and recursion fixtures

ears.precondition: cargo-pgrx is invoked outside an Engine fabrics/data development shell
ears.response: resolve the nearest Engine fabrics/data flake or canonical fallback and execute its Nix-owned cargo-pgrx with unchanged arguments

breaker.condition: the wrapper selects an unrelated flake, drops arguments, or recursively invokes itself

added.statement: The activated host shall execute cargo-pgrx 0.18.0 without SIGILL from normal and Engine workspace shells after the incompatible unmanaged Cargo install is removed.
acceptance_criteria: home-manager switch activates the managed wrapper
command -v cargo-pgrx resolves to ~/.local/bin/cargo-pgrx outside a Nix development shell
cargo pgrx --help exits 0 from /home/mhugo and a writable Engine workspace
cargo-pgrx reports version 0.18.0
the Engine fabrics/data development shell resolves its Nix store cargo-pgrx before ~/.local/bin
no new stored SIGILL coredump appears after the probes

ears.trigger: the host-compatible command is invoked by JCode or the operator
ears.response: execute cargo-pgrx 0.18.0 successfully without an illegal instruction or recursive wrapper

breaker.condition: a live help probe exits non-zero, reports another version, resolves the removed unmanaged install, or creates a stored SIGILL coredump
